title: Federal Reserve Banks: 2025 Report on Employer Firms (2024 Small Business Credit Survey)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

reliability: Primary report by the Federal Reserve Banks; convenience sample, weighted by the authors. Publication day inferred from the report DOI (sbcs-20250327); cover says "Published March 2025".
findings: The survey was open September 4 to November 4, 2024 and yielded 7,653 responses from a nationwide convenience sample of small employer firms with 1-499 employees in all 50 states and DC.

Operational challenges in the prior 12 months (read from chart text): complying with government regulations 25% in the 2023 survey (N=6,056) and 29% in the 2024 survey (N=7,545); reaching customers and growing sales 53% then 57%; hiring or retaining qualified staff 54% then 51%; utilizing technology 26% then 29%; 9% reported no operational challenges in either year.
The report states reaching customers and growing sales was the most commonly reported operational challenge in 2024.
limitations: Chart values were extracted from PDF text; the 2023-then-2024 column order was inferred, consistent with the narrative for the reaching-customers row.
Convenience sample; results may not generalize.
No indication of which regulations or what cost.
